description: Warehouse drone agent modeled on Section 2.3: reaches the top shelf and carries light items. Limits: Cannot carry heavy items or reach the middle shelf. Top-shelf retrieval only. Capability does not grant access: protected resources require a valid, unrevoked permission for the authorized task interval. Core capabilities are reach_top_shelf and carry_light_items. The supplementary deliver_to_safe_zone skill adds gate traversal and placement in the designated zone when the task requires them. Retrieval and transport suitability depend on the core skills; delivery alone does not establish suitability. Execution uses the shared simulated workflow, subject to SST access permissions and the stated shelf and payload limits.
name: Drone Agent

skills.name: Reach top shelf
skills.description: Access to a top-shelf storage location for retrieval.
examples: Plan retrieving a light item from the top shelf.

skills.name: Carry light items
skills.description: Transport of light items within the agent's shelf-reach limits. Heavy loads are unsupported; unspecified load classifications require clarification.
examples: Plan carrying a light item retrieved from the top shelf.

skills.name: Supplementary delivery to designated zone
skills.description: Supplement reach_top_shelf and carry_light_items with gate traversal and placement in the designated zone. For a retrieval-and-delivery task, use these skills together: reach_top_shelf covers shelf access, carry_light_items covers item transport, and deliver_to_safe_zone covers the gate and destination steps. This supplementary skill does not independently provide retrieval, shelf reach, or payload capability, and is not required for tasks that only concern the core skills. The shared simulated execution workflow coordinates the combined task. Delivery requires valid SST access to both the item and gate; shelf-reach and payload limits still apply.
examples: Combine reach_top_shelf, carry_light_items, and deliver_to_safe_zone to retrieve a light item from the top shelf and deliver it through the gate to the designated zone.
